title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1971-07-02
source: Pre-FM MSR>DAT>CD (to the best of my recollection)

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a solid night, highlighted by a smoking Hard to Handle and The Other One.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the pristine mix – organ and guitars sit up front, Bob’s rhythm is audible, and Phil’s bass sings with resonant reverb. The performance itself is described as “solid” and worthy of a historic Fillmore West finale, with Hard to Handle and The Other One standing out as the night’s peaks.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance (high energy, standout songs) and the recording quality (excellent clarity), though only two reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Excellent sound quality and instrument separation; organ not buried, Bob’s guitar clear, superb bass resonance with reverb intact after many years.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid, consistently engaging set that feels like a fitting final Fillmore West show; transitions smooth and energy sustained throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for superb reverb‑rich bass resonance and overall powerful presence.
band_member_comments.Bob: Clearly mixed and audible, contributing to the solid overall sound.
